statement.excerpt: And we have yet to see any evidence that any kind of prompt helps in that regard.
statement.document_title: Reports of LLMs mastering math have been greatly exaggerated

from_speaker: say “I give up” when they can’t
our_interpretation: We refers to Ernest Davis and Gary Marcus. The claim concerns evidence they had encountered by publication, not all publicly available research.
In that regard refers to admitting inability to solve the mathematical proof problems under discussion instead of claiming an invalid solution.
Helps means improves appropriate acknowledgment of failure compared with a relevant baseline; it does not require perfect abstention.
The phrase have yet to see describes their experience through April 5, 2025, with no specified starting date.
criteria.support_condition: Independently corroborated records of the authors' relevant evidence exposure establish that neither had encountered evidence of prompting improving appropriate admission of failure on these mathematical reasoning tasks by publication.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Dated records establish that, before publication, the authors had encountered relevant evidence showing such an improvement. Publication of a study alone is insufficient.
